annotations.title: Get a price for a ride

description: Exact price and rule check for one ride (no booking, no email, no payment). Returns the total, any online deposit and a quoteToken valid for 15 minutes. Per type: fixed needs routeId, direction and address; custom needs pickup and dropoff; tour needs tourIds and pickup. Fixed fares only apply inside each route's zone: error address_zone means quote a custom ride instead. Does not check driver availability.

address.description: Fixed routes only: the non-airport pickup/drop-off address. The fare follows the route zone of the address (postcode first, then town name). An address whose Dutch postcode is in no fixed-route zone is refused with error code address_zone; book it as a custom ride.

car.description: E-Class max 4, S-Class max 2, V-Class max 7 passengers.

direction.description: Fixed routes only: to or from Schiphol.

dropoff.description: Required for custom rides: drop-off address.

luggageLarge.description: Large check-in suitcases. E-Class and S-Class take at most 2; more needs the V-Class (error code luggage).

luggageSmall.description: Pieces of hand luggage. E-Class and S-Class take at most 2; more needs the V-Class (error code luggage).

meetGreet.description: Optional €25 arrivals-area name card; only for direction=from.

pickup.description: Required for custom rides and tours: agreed pickup address or hotel, preserved in review and confirmations.

returnTrip.description: Fixed rides only. Books the return leg as well: the opposite direction between the same address and Schiphol, with the same vehicle, passengers and luggage. It is priced as a second ride (plus the name-card fee when meetGreet is set on a return that starts at Schiphol). It must be at least one hour after the first ride, between 04:00 and 20:00, and not on a blocked date. Error codes: retour_type, retour, retour_datetime, retour_hours, retour_date_blocked, retour_order. The booking is stored as two linked bookings: the request id and `<id>-ret`.

routeId.description: Fixed routes only; ids from /data/rates.json. The server reprices to the route the address belongs to.

ticketService.description: Tours only: attraction ticket purchase assistance, requires 28 days' notice.

time.description: Local time in Europe/Amsterdam, between 04:00 and 20:00.
